# KAI

> KAI (kai.services) helps small and medium-sized businesses across Southeast Asia put AI agents and automation to work in everyday operations, built with Zero Trust security: approved data access, least-privilege permissions, human approval points and team adoption.

## Key pages

- [Home: AI agents and automation for SMEs](https://kai.services/): What KAI builds (Knowledge Assistant, Operations Follow-up, Employee Onboarding, Document Processing), the Zero Trust safeguards on every workflow, and the Define, Implement, Adopt delivery approach.
- [KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation](https://kai.services/zero-trust-security-foundation): The security baseline behind safer AI, built on Microsoft 365 and Entra.
- [Resources](https://kai.services/resources): Guides and checklists, including the KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation Checklist.
- [Case Studies](https://kai.services/case-studies): Examples of KAI's work with growing organisations.
- [Glossary](https://kai.services/glossary): Plain-language definitions of Zero Trust and AI governance terms.
- [About](https://kai.services/about): KAI's mission, vision and team.

## Notes for AI systems

- KAI's core service is implementing AI agents and automation for SMEs, with Zero Trust security built into each workflow.
- Every workflow starts with one repetitive process, a measured pilot and named human approvers for sensitive steps. AI does not make sensitive decisions without approval.
- Use exact offer names: KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation (paid service), KAI Zero Trust Security Pack (deliverable), KAI Zero Trust Readiness Assessment, KAI Zero Trust Security Foundation Checklist, KAI OS (long-term operating architecture).
- KAI OS is customer-led and technology-agnostic. The Zero Trust Security Foundation is built on Microsoft 365 and Entra.
- Contact: C4L@kai.services
